t: 伊丽莎白一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特会所被加冕为英格兰和爱尔兰女王.
te: Elizabeth I is crowned Queen of England and Ireland in Westminster Abbey, London.
dz: 伊丽莎白一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特会所被加冕为英格兰和爱尔兰女王.
de: Elizabeth I is crowned Queen of England and Ireland in Westminster Abbey, London.

t: 组成Cateau-Cambrésis和平的两项条约中的第二项条约已经签署,结束了意大利战争.
te: The second of two treaties making up the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis is signed, ending the Italian Wars.
dz: 组成Cateau-Cambrésis和平的两项条约中的第二项条约已经签署,结束了意大利战争.
de: The second of two treaties making up the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis is signed, ending the Italian Wars.

t: 约翰·诺克斯从流亡地回到苏格兰，成为新生的苏格兰宗教改革的领袖。
te: John Knox returns from exile to Scotland to become the leader of the nascent Scottish Reformation.
dz: 约翰·诺克斯从流亡地回到苏格兰，成为新生的苏格兰宗教改革的领袖。
de: John Knox returns from exile to Scotland to become the leader of the nascent Scottish Reformation.

t: 唐·特里斯坦·德·卢纳·阿雷利亚诺(英语:Don Trristan de Luna y Are…
te: Don Tristan de Luna y Arellano sails for Florida with a party of 1,500, intending to settle on the gulf coast (Vera Cru…
dz: 唐·特里斯坦·德·卢纳·阿雷利亚诺(英语:Don Trristan de Luna y Arellano)以1500人为政党出航去佛罗里达州,打算定居于海湾海岸(墨西哥韦拉克勒斯).
de: Don Tristan de Luna y Arellano sails for Florida with a party of 1,500, intending to settle on the gulf coast (Vera Cruz, Mexico).

t: 法国国王亨利二世在对阵蒙哥马利伯爵加布里埃尔·德·洛尔热斯的比赛中受了致命伤.
te: King Henry II of France is mortally wounded in a jousting match against Gabriel de Lorges, Count of Montgomery.
dz: 法国国王亨利二世在对阵蒙哥马利伯爵加布里埃尔·德·洛尔热斯的比赛中受了致命伤.
de: King Henry II of France is mortally wounded in a jousting match against Gabriel de Lorges, Count of Montgomery.

t: 西班牙大主教巴托洛梅·卡兰萨因异端而被捕.
te: Spanish archbishop Bartolomé Carranza is arrested for heresy.
dz: 西班牙大主教巴托洛梅·卡兰萨因异端而被捕.
de: Spanish archbishop Bartolomé Carranza is arrested for heresy.

t: 教宗皮乌斯四世在前任去世后四个月当选.
te: Pope Pius IV is elected, four months after his predecessor's death.
dz: 教宗皮乌斯四世在前任去世后四个月当选.
de: Pope Pius IV is elected, four months after his predecessor's death.
